DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通りで口論を聞きました。日本語を全部は理解できなかったので、聞いた言葉と私の考えを分けて伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通りの口論で日本語を全て理解できなかったので、聞いた言葉と自分の解釈を分けて報告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard an argument in the street. I could not understand all the Japanese, so I want to distinguish the words I heard from my own interpretation when reporting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you did not understand all the Japanese in a street argument and want to report the words you heard separately from your interpretation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所ですか。まだその場で続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you somewhere safe now? Is it still going on there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は離れた安全な所です。今も続いているかは見えません。聞いた場所は地図で示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 離れた安全な場所にいて口論が続いているかは見えず、聞いた場所は地図で示せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am at a safe distance. I cannot see whether it is still continuing. I can show where I heard it on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are a safe distance away and cannot see whether the argument continues, but can show the location on a map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見聞きした時の状況を教えてください。聞き取れた言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the situation when you saw and heard it. Were there words you could make out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 覚えている日本語は「返して」です。母語では脅す命令のように訳してしまいましたが、その意味だったかはわかりません。実際に聞いた言葉は「返して」だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原語は返してだけで、母語では脅す命令のように訳したが発言の意味を確認できていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The Japanese I remember is 'kaeshite', meaning 'give it back'. I translated it in my native language like a threatening command, but I do not know if that was the meaning. The only word I actually heard was 'kaeshite'.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the original wording was only 'kaeshite' and you translated it as a threatening command in your language, but have not confirmed that meaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原語の「返して」を記録します。脅す意味だったというのはご自身の解釈で、発言の意図は未確認ですね。ほかに実際に見えた動きはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record the original Japanese 'kaeshite'. The threatening meaning is your interpretation, and the speaker's intent is unconfirmed. Did you actually see any other movements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人の動きも少し見ました。手を上げたのは見ましたが、相手に当たったかは障害物で見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手を上げた動きは見たが、相手に当たったかは障害物で見えなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw a little of their movements too. I saw a raised hand, but an obstruction blocked my view of whether it struck the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw a raised hand but could not see whether it hit the other person because of an obstruction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録は、日本語「返して」、手を上げた動きは見た、接触は障害物で見えなかった、です。訳した意味や相手に当たったという断定は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The record is: the Japanese 'kaeshite'; a raised hand was seen; contact could not be seen because of an obstruction. It does not include your translated meaning or a conclusion that the other person was struck.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その記録で合っています。「返して」と聞いたことと手を上げた動きだけで、意図や接触はわかりません。場所と時刻も地図とメモで示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返してという原語と手を上げた動きだけが確認済みで意図と接触は不明という記録を確認し、場所と時刻も示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That record is correct. I only heard 'kaeshite' and saw the raised hand; I do not know the intent or whether there was contact. I will also show the location and time using a map and note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the record that only the original word 'kaeshite' and raised-hand movement are verified while intent and contact are unknown, and say you will show the location and time too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が状況を確認します。安全な位置からお知らせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the situation. Thank you for reporting from a safe position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手紙の発送で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you mail your letters?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人へ礼状を送ります。写真がそれぞれ違うので、封をする前に一通ずつ整理できる場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人にそれぞれ違う写真入りの礼状を送るので、封をする前に一通ずつ整理できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending thank-you letters to three people. Each has different photos, so I would like to know where I can organize one letter at a time before sealing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can organize one letter at a time before sealing because you are sending three people thank-you letters with different photos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の封筒はまだ開いていますか。どの写真を誰に送るかは決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the envelopes still open? Have you decided which photos go to whom?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開いています。裏に小さく相手の名前を書いた袋へ、各人の写真を分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒はまだ開いていて、相手の名前を書いた袋に写真を分けていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are open. I have separated each person's photos into bags with the recipient's name written small on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the envelopes are still open and the photos are separated into bags labeled with the recipients' names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付横の机を使えます。三通を一度に広げるか、一通ずつ確認するか、混ざらない順番を決めてから作業してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the table beside reception. Before starting, choose an order that avoids mixing them up, whether opening all three at once or checking one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度に三つ開けて並べると混ぜそうです。一通確認して封をしてから、次へ進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三通を同時に開くと混同しそうなので、一通を確認して封をしてから次に進みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I open and lay out all three at once, I might mix them up. I want to check and seal one before moving on to the next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that opening all three at once could cause a mix-up, so you want to check and seal one before proceeding to the next. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順で確認できますね。差出人の情報は三通とも同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check them in that order. Is the sender information the same on all three?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じです。相手ごとの礼状だけ入れ替えるので、名前を読み上げて写真の袋と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人情報は三通とも同じで、相手ごとの礼状と写真の袋を名前で照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Only the recipient-specific letters differ, so I will read the names aloud and compare them with the photo bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the sender information is the same for all three and you will match each recipient's letter and photo bag by name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に封筒の枚数と宛先を確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Finally, please check the number of envelopes and their addresses before bringing them over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 各通の宛先、礼状、写真をそろえて一通ずつ封をします。三通完成してから、発送の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先、礼状、写真を合わせて一通ずつ封をし、三通が完成してから発送の確認を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match each address, letter and photos and seal them one at a time. Once all three are ready, please check them for mailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will match each address, letter and photos and seal one at a time, then ask for a mailing check after all three are complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたらお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when you are ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振込みの記録で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your transfer records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手から支払いの記録を送ってほしいと言われました。画面を撮る前に、どの記録を使うか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手に支払い記録を送る必要があるので、撮影する前に使う記録を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient asked me to send a payment record. Before taking a screenshot, I want to check which record to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you need to send a payment record to the recipient and want to confirm which one to use before taking a screenshot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手続きが完了した記録ですか。それとも入力途中の画面ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it a record of a completed transaction or a screen from while you were entering details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完了の記録があります。入力途中の画面も残っているので、そちらを間違えて送らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完了記録と入力途中の画面があり、途中の画面を間違えて送らないようにすると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the completion record. I also have an unfinished entry screen saved, so I will take care not to send that one by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have both the completion record and an unfinished entry screen and will avoid sending the unfinished screen by mistake. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録の意味を確認できます。相手はどの情報が必要と言っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check what each record means. Which information does the recipient say they need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 支払日と金額、私の名前です。残高やほかの取引まで見せる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手が必要としているのは支払日、金額、自分の名前で、残高や他の取引は見せる必要がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The payment date, amount and my name. There is no need to show my balance or other transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the recipient needs the payment date, amount and your name, but not your balance or other transactions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な項目が確認できる記録を選びましょう。提供する方法は相手にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us choose a record showing the necessary items. Please also confirm the delivery method with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの取引が同じ画面に見えています。全部撮るのではなく、一件の記録を表示できるか担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の取引も映る画面全体を撮らず、一件の完了記録を表示できるか担当者に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Other transactions appear on the same screen. Rather than capture all of it, I want to ask the person in charge whether I can display a single transaction record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want to capture the whole screen with other transactions and want to ask whether a single completed transaction can be displayed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この画面の「詳細を見る」を開き、選択した一件の完了記録を表示しました。支払日・金額・依頼人名があり、残高やほかの取引一覧は表示されていません。内容を編集せず、送る前に相手の必要項目と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I opened 'View details' on this screen and displayed the selected completed transaction. It shows the payment date, amount and sender name, without the balance or other transaction list. Do not edit the content; compare it with the recipient's required items before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一件の完了記録を選び、支払日、金額、私の名前が読める形で相手へ示します。ほかの取引一覧は送らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一件の完了記録から支払日、金額、自分の名前を読める形で示し、他の取引一覧は送らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose the single completed transaction record and show the recipient the payment date, amount and my name in readable form. I will avoid sending the list of other transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the payment date, amount and your name readably from one completed transaction record, without sending the list of other transactions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仲間の弁当を三つ買います。中身が違うので、受け取る人がわかるように分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仲間の弁当を三つ買い、中身が違うので受け取る人が分かるように分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am buying three boxed lunches for my companions. The contents differ, so I want to separate them so we can tell who gets which.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are buying three boxed lunches for your companions and want to separate them by recipient because the contents differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三つとも同じ商品ではないのですね。表示は見分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So they are not all the same product. Can you distinguish the labels?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つは魚、一つは肉です。容器が似ていますが、商品名のシールは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 魚が二つ、肉が一つで容器は似ているが、商品名のシールは違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two are fish and one is meat. The containers look similar, but the product-name stickers differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two fish lunches and one meat lunch, with similar containers but different product-name stickers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品名を見て分けられます。持ち帰った後も表示が読めるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can separate them using the product names. Please keep the labels readable after taking them home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 魚二つは同じ袋、肉は別にしたいです。食品に直接名前を書くのではなく、袋へ印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 魚二つは一袋、肉は別袋にし、食品へ直接書かず袋に印を付けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like the two fish lunches in one bag and the meat separately. I will mark the bags rather than write names directly on the food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want the two fish lunches in one bag and the meat in another, and will mark the bags rather than write directly on the food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の希望はレジでお伝えください。持ち帰る時間も商品の表示と合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the checkout staff about your bagging preferences. Let us also check the travel time against the product labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐ戻って渡します。袋を分けたから保存条件が変わるとは思わず、全員に表示を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: すぐ戻って渡すが袋分けで保存条件は変わらないので、全員に表示を確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will return and hand them over right away. I will not assume separating the bags changes the storage conditions, and I will have everyone read the labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will return and distribute them immediately, but separate bags do not change the storage conditions, so you will have everyone check the labels. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら商品名と取扱いを一緒に伝えられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you can communicate the product names and handling instructions together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 魚二つと肉一つをレジで示し、袋に印を付けます。渡す時も中身と表示を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レジで魚二つと肉一つを示して袋に印を付け、渡す時も中身と取扱い表示を確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will point out the two fish lunches and one meat lunch at checkout and mark the bags. I will also have people check the contents and labels when handing them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will identify the two fish lunches and one meat lunch at checkout, mark the bags, and have the recipients check the contents and handling labels on handover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。レジで袋分けをご相談ください。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please discuss separate bags at checkout. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと遊びたいです。私は先に写真を撮りたいのですが、子どもはすぐ遊びたがるので、待つ場所も含め相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供と公園で遊びたいが、撮影と遊びの希望が違うため待つ場所も含めて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to play with my child. I would like to take photos first, but my child wants to play right away, so I would like advice including where to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice including where to wait because you and your child want to play at the park but differ about photos and playtime. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遊具の案内は確認しましたか。お子さんはどの遊びを希望していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the playground instructions? Which activity does your child want to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 滑る遊具を指しています。対象や使い方を見てから、一緒にどこで待つか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供は滑り台を使いたがっているので、対象と使い方を見てから待つ場所を一緒に決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child is pointing to the slide. I want to check the age suitability and instructions before deciding together where to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your child wants to use the slide and you want to check who it is for and how to use it before deciding together where to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用条件を確認し、遊ぶ方の邪魔にならない場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the conditions of use and wait where you will not obstruct people playing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遊具を止めて写真を撮るのはやめます。先に遊び、休憩してから撮れるか子どもに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遊具を止めて撮影せず先に遊び、休憩してから撮影できるか子供に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not stop the equipment for a photo. We will play first, and I will ask my child whether we can take photos after having a break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not stop the play equipment for photos, will play first, then ask your child about taking photos after a break. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 順番を相談できますね。撮る時も、ほかのお子さんが写らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can discuss the order. When taking photos, make sure other children are not in the picture.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の子だけを撮れる時にします。嫌がったら撮らず、一緒に休憩する時間を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の子だけが写る時に撮り、嫌がれば撮らず一緒に休憩する時間を取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take them when I can photograph only my own child. If my child does not want to, I will not take photos and will make time to rest together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will photograph only your own child, stop if they dislike it, and make time to rest together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お子さんの様子を見て、無理のない予定にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Watch your child's condition and make a manageable plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を確認して遊ぶのを先にします。撮影は休憩時に子どもの希望を聞き、通行やほかの子を妨げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を確認して先に遊び、休憩時に子供の撮影希望を聞き、通行や他の子供を妨げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the instructions and prioritize play. During a break, I will ask my child what they want about photos and will not obstruct paths or other children.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the instructions and play first, ask your child about photos during a break, and avoid obstructing people passing or other children. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。親子で楽しくお過ごしください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy your time together. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お帰りの移動で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your return journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 北広島で催しを見た後に帰ります。来た時の道が混むかもしれないので、帰りの案内を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 催しの後に帰るので、来た道が混む可能性を考えて帰りの案内を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will return after attending an event in Kitahiroshima. The route I came on may be crowded, so I would like to check the return guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will return after an event and want to check return guidance considering that the route you used to arrive may be crowded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会場から駅までの案内と、乗る列車は確認していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the directions from the venue to the station and which train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列車は候補がありますが、会場を出る道はまだです。昼に来た入口から必ず帰れるとは思わず調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車の候補はあるが退場経路は未確認で、昼に入った入口から必ず帰れるとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have some train options, but have not checked how to exit the venue yet. I want to look into it without assuming I can leave through the entrance I used at midday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have train options but have not checked the exit route and will not assume you can use the entrance you came through at midday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 催しの案内で退場経路を確認しましょう。同行者とはどこで合流する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the event information for exit routes. Where do you plan to meet your companions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会場の外で別々に探すより、出る前に連絡します。混雑で通話できなければ、案内された目印を使う予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外で探し合わず退場前に連絡し、通話が難しければ会場案内で確認した目印を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than look for each other separately outside, I will contact them before leaving. If crowds make phone calls difficult, we plan to use a landmark confirmed in the venue guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your companions before exiting rather than search separately outside, and use a landmark confirmed in the venue guidance if calling is difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 正式な目印と、利用できる場所を会場の案内で確かめてください。帰りの時刻には余裕がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the official landmark and usable meeting locations in the venue guidance. Have you allowed enough time for your return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終電だけを目標にせず、早い候補も見ます。退場と歩行にかかる時間を列車の乗車時間と分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終電だけを狙わず早い候補も調べ、退場や歩行の時間と列車の移動時間を分けて考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at earlier options rather than aim only for the last train. I will consider the time to exit and walk separately from the train travel time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will look at earlier trains rather than only aim for the last train and consider exit and walking time separately from train travel time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 混雑時は係員の案内に従い、急いで危ない移動をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow staff guidance during crowds and do not rush into unsafe movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 退場経路と合流点を確認し、余裕のある列車候補を持ちます。間に合わない時の連絡も同行者と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退場経路と合流点、余裕のある列車を確認し、間に合わない場合の連絡も同行者と決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the exit route and meeting point and have train options with enough time. I will also agree with my companions how to contact each other if we will not make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the exit route, meeting point and trains with enough time, and agree with companions how to communicate if you cannot make it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内に従って、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Follow the guidance and travel home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。地域の相談で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with community advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 図書館で地域活動の冊子を読みました。参加を考えていますが、今も同じ相談先か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図書館で読んだ地域活動の冊子に興味があるので、現在の相談先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I read a booklet about community activities at the library. I am considering joining and want to check whether the contact is still the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are interested in a community activity booklet you read at the library and want to confirm the current contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 冊子の発行年と、気になった活動名はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the booklet's publication year and the activity name that interested you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 2018年発行です。住民が集まる交流活動に興味があります。古い担当者名のまま連絡する前に、現在の窓口を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冊子は2018年発行で交流活動に関心があり、古い担当者名で連絡する前に現在の窓口を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was published in 2018. I am interested in exchange activities where residents gather. Before contacting someone under the old staff member's name, I want to know the current desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the booklet is from 2018, you are interested in exchange activities, and you want the current contact before using the old staff name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この現行案内では相談先が「地域交流係」になっています。2018年の冊子の個人名ではありません。参加者として知りたいのですか、それとも運営を手伝いたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This current guide lists the Community Exchange Section as the contact, rather than the individual named in the 2018 booklet. Are you asking as a participant, or do you want to help run the activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず参加者として様子を知りたいです。日本語で長い説明をするのはまだ難しいので、見学できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まず参加者として内容を知りたく、日本語の長い説明は難しいため見学も可能か尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: First, I want to learn about it as a participant. Long explanations in Japanese are still difficult for me, so I also want to ask whether I can observe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you first want to learn as a participant and ask about observing because giving a long explanation in Japanese is difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現行案内には初回見学の相談枠があります。日時は地域交流係へ確認が必要です。まず、参加者として関心を一文で伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The current guide offers a chance to discuss a first observation visit. You need to check the date and time with the Community Exchange Section. Could you first express your interest as a participant in one sentence?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「最近この町に住み始めたので、住民の交流活動を一度見学したいです」と伝えます。初回から運営を引き受けず、内容を見てから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最近この町に住み始めたので交流活動を一度見学したいという一文を伝え、初回から運営は引き受けないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will say, 'I recently moved to this town and would like to observe a residents' exchange activity once.' I will not take on organizing from the first visit, but consider it after seeing what it involves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in one sentence that you recently moved to the town and want to observe an exchange activity once, and explain you will not take on organizing from the first visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加者として見学を希望する、ですね。この案内に地域交流係への連絡方法が記載されています。見学日時はまだ申し込んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you would like to observe as a participant. This guide lists how to contact the Community Exchange Section. No observation date has been applied for yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 2018年の担当名ではなく、現行案内の地域交流係へ、その一文で見学を相談します。日時を確認し、内容を見てから手伝う範囲を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い個人名でなく現行案内の地域交流係へ一文で見学を相談し、日時を確かめ内容を見てから手伝う範囲を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use that sentence to ask the Community Exchange Section in the current guide about observing, rather than contact the person named in 2018. I will confirm the date and decide how much to help after seeing the activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the current guide's Community Exchange Section about observing using one sentence rather than an old person's name, confirm the date, and consider how much to help after seeing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談先を確認します。ご興味を持っていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will confirm the contact point. Thank you for your interest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の予定で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your medical visit schedule?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は二つの科に予約があります。先にどちらの受付へ行くか、二枚の予約票で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同日に二科の予約があるので、二枚の予約票で最初に行く受付を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have appointments with two departments today. I would like to use both appointment slips to check which reception I should go to first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have appointments with two departments on the same day and want to check the first reception using the two appointment slips. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票Aは9時に受付A、予約票Bは11時に受付Bと書かれています。同時刻ではありませんね。まず受付Aへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Slip A says reception A at 9 a.m., and slip B says reception B at 11 a.m. They are not at the same time. Please go to reception A first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時間は違います。でも一つ目が長くなったら、二つ目へ何も言わず遅れてよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻は違うが一科目が長引いても二科目へ無断で遅れてよいとは考えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The times differ. But if the first appointment takes a long time, I do not assume I may be late for the second without telling anyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the appointment times differ, but even if the first department takes longer, you will not assume you may be late to the second without notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つ目が長引きそうな時は、受付Aの職員へ「11時に受付Bの予約がある」と伝えてください。こちらからBへ連絡する案内です。持参書類は分けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: If the first appointment looks likely to run long, tell reception A staff that you have an 11 a.m. appointment at reception B. The arrangement is for us to contact B. Have you separated your documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つ目の資料に、二つ目への質問メモが混ざっています。資料と質問を科ごとに分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一科目の資料に二科目への質問が混ざっているので、科ごとに分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My question note for the second department is mixed with the first department's documents. I want to separate the documents and questions by department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that questions for the second department are mixed with the first department's documents and you want to separate them by department. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: Aの資料はこちら、Bへの質問メモはBの票と一緒に分けました。両方で使う共通の資料もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have put A's documents here and separated the questions for B with B's slip. Are there shared documents you need at both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 服用している薬の一覧は両方へ見せたいです。一つ目で預ける場合は、二つ目でも使うことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬の一覧は両科に示したく、最初の科に預ける場合も次の科で必要だと説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to show my current medication list to both. If I leave it at the first department, I will explain that I need it at the second too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want both departments to see your medication list, and if you leave it at the first, you will explain it is needed at the next too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望に合わせて薬の一覧を二枚用意しました。A用とB用の資料に一枚ずつ入れます。内容に違いがないか見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have prepared two copies of the medication list as you requested. We will put one with A's documents and one with B's. Please compare them to make sure the contents do not differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚の薬一覧は同じ内容ですね。A用とB用に入れました。9時のAへ先に行き、11時のBに遅れそうならAの職員に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同内容の薬一覧をA用とB用に分け、9時の受付Aへ先に行き、11時のBに遅れそうならA職員に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The two medication lists have the same contents. I put them with A's and B's documents. I will go to A at 9 a.m. first and tell A's staff if I am likely to be late for B at 11.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you separated identical medication lists into A's and B's sets, will go first to reception A at 9 a.m., and tell A's staff if likely to be late for B at 11. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、資料が分かれました。受付Aの表示はこちらです。診察にかかる時間はお約束できませんので、遅れの見込みは職員へお知らせください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, the documents are now separated. Reception A is indicated here. We cannot promise how long the consultation will take, so please notify staff if you expect a delay. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人から電話を貸してほしいと言われました。助けたいですが、携帯をそのまま渡すのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない人に携帯を貸してほしいと言われ、助けたいが端末を渡すのは不安だと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger asked to borrow my phone. I want to help, but I am uneasy about handing over my mobile as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because a stranger wants to borrow your mobile and you want to help but are uneasy about handing over the device. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方はどのような用件と言っていますか。今、端末はご自身で持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does the person say they need it for? Do you still have the device yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰る相手へ連絡したいそうです。端末はまだ自分で持っています。相手が困っている理由までは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手は帰る先へ連絡したいと言うが理由は未確認で、携帯はまだ自分で持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say they want to contact the person they are going back to. I still have my phone. I have not confirmed exactly why they are having trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the person wants to contact someone where they are returning, but the reason is unconfirmed and you still have your phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に端末を渡さず、施設の案内などで連絡方法を相談できます。現在、緊急の危険はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You do not have to hand over the device; you can ask facility information staff about ways to make contact. Is there any immediate danger now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た範囲ではわかりません。相手を犯罪者だと決めるのではなく、こちらで相談できるか案内したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緊急の危険があるかは分からず、相手を犯罪者と決めず相談先を案内したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot tell from what I have seen. Rather than decide the person is a criminal, I would like to show them that they can ask for help here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether there is immediate danger and want to direct the person to help without deciding they are a criminal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 困っている方を相談先へ案内する方法があります。ご自身の端末や個人情報は無理に見せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can direct someone in difficulty to an advice desk. Do not feel obliged to show your own device or personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の画面を開いて番号を探させるのはやめます。ここで連絡について聞けると伝え、必要なら係の方へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を探させるため画面を渡さず、窓口で連絡方法を相談できると知らせて必要なら係員に説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not open my screen and let them look for a number. I will tell them they can ask about making contact here and explain to staff if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not hand over your screen for them to search contacts, will explain that the desk can advise on contact methods, and will explain to staff if needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。緊急の事情があるとわかったら、その内容を担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. If you learn there is an emergency, tell the person in charge what it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 端末は手元に置き、相談先を案内します。困っている用件は本人に説明してもらい、私の連絡先一覧は見せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯は手元に置いて相談先を案内し、用件は本人に説明してもらい自分の連絡先一覧は見せないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep my phone with me and direct them to the advice desk. I will have them explain their difficulty themselves and will not show my contact list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep your mobile, direct the person to help, let them explain their own situation, and not show your contact list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身の安全にも配慮してご案内ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be mindful of your own safety while guiding them. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。荷物の発送で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you send your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた機器を返します。本体だけ送ると不足するかもしれないので、付属品を整理してから発送したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた機器を返すので、本体だけでは不足する可能性があり付属品を整理して発送したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am returning borrowed equipment. Sending only the main unit may be insufficient, so I want to organize the accessories before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are returning borrowed equipment and want to organize the accessories before sending because the main unit alone may be insufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返却先から付属品の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the return recipient provided instructions about accessories?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本体とケーブルとあります。でも二本のケーブルがあり、一本は私が買った物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定は本体とケーブルだが、二本あるケーブルの一つは自分で購入した物だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say the main unit and cable. But there are two cables, and I bought one of them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the instructions specify the main unit and cable, but one of the two cables belongs to you because you bought it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の物と借りた物を分けて確認しましょう。どちらが付属品か相手へ聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate your belongings from the borrowed ones. Can you ask the recipient which cable is the accessory?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真を送って聞きます。形が合う方ならどちらでもよいと自分で決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形が合えばどちらでもよいと判断せず、写真で返却先に付属品を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send photos and ask. I will not decide for myself that either cable is fine as long as it fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the accessory with the recipient using photos rather than assume either cable is fine if it fits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の確認後に内容をそろえてください。機器の発送条件も担当へ照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please assemble the contents after the recipient confirms. You can also ask the person in charge about the shipping conditions for the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できたら、本体と指定のケーブルを同じ袋へ入れます。私物のカードなどが中に残っていないかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認できた本体とケーブルを同じ袋に入れ、私物のカードが残っていないかも調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once confirmed, I will put the main unit and specified cable in the same bag. I will also check that no personal cards or similar belongings remain inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the confirmed main unit and cable in the same bag and check that no personal card remains inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返送予定は本体と、相手が確認した付属ケーブルです。二本のうちどちらを入れるかは返答待ちですね。ご自身のケーブルと私物カードを分け、内容がそろってから梱包と発送条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The planned return consists of the main unit and the accessory cable confirmed by the recipient. You are still awaiting the reply about which of the two cables to include. Separate your own cable and personal cards, then check packaging and shipping conditions once the contents are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手に確認した付属品だけ返します。自分のケーブルやカードは分け、機器の取扱い条件を聞いて発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認された付属品だけを返し、自分のケーブルやカードを分け、発送時の取扱い条件も聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return only the accessories the recipient confirms. I will separate my own cable and cards and ask about the equipment's handling conditions before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return only the confirmed accessories, separate your own cable and cards, and also ask about handling conditions for shipping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備が整いましたらご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us when everything is ready. Thank you.
